annotations.title: Make a one-time link that connects the teammate's Slack account

description: Make a one-time link that connects the teammate's Slack account. Open it in the browser signed in to Slack as the teammate and select Allow; no Summer sign-in is needed there. It works once, for 15 minutes, and the connection is recorded as yours. Treat the link like a password. Needs a company owner or administrator.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change
